consumption_rule: Only a ready spec supports instantiation under its stated premises. Choose one complete allowed branch and obey every applicable constraint; never conjoin mutually exclusive branches. Partial/conflict specs retain useful claims but do not establish a complete valid Mock. Evidence linkage is not a proof of entailment.
